newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber price seen falling 18.9 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber price seen falling 18.9 pct in '97.

text.p: The average price of Malaysia's benchmark RSS1, or Ribbed Smoked Sheet 1 rubber, is projected to fall by 18.9 percent to 300 cents/kg in 1997, the Finance Ministry said in its annual economic report on Friday.
The average price of RSS1 in 1996 is projected to be 370 Malaysian cents a kilo, it said.
Total production of rubber in Malaysia is forecast to fall 5.6 percent to 1.01 million tonnes in 1997 from a projected 1.07 million tonnes in 1996 and against 1.09 million in 1995.
The report estimated rubber exports would fall 6.2 percent to 950,000 tonnes in 1996 from 1.013 million tonnes in 1995, due to reduced demand and cutbacks in autombile output.
RSS exports were expected to dip 3.3 percent to 42,500 tonnes in 1996 from 43,968 tonnes last year.
Latex exports were forecast to fall 5.1 percent to 103,200 tonnes in 1996 from 108,735 tonnes in 1995.

Total rubber hectarage was expected to shrink by 0.6 percent to 1.71 million hectares in 1996 from last year's 1.72 million hectares, due to labour shortages and conversion to oil palm or other commercial uses, the report said.
